name: Three Small Investigations

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style Title.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style F24Art.

recognitionRules: Use Trebuchet route headings with plain Arial instructions.
Make the route choice visible before the activities.
Keep each investigation to a looking prompt, an action and a response.
Separate optional extensions from the core visit.
Use blue response boundaries and pale amber guide-dialogue strips; keep route drawings and black instructions distinct.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Choose a route. Look for one detail. See where it leads.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use THREE SMALL INVESTIGATIONS in Trebuchet with three open dots connected by separate short strokes. Avoid a single mandatory path arrow.
invariants: Use Trebuchet route headings with plain Arial instructions.
Make the route choice visible before the activities.
Keep each investigation to a looking prompt, an action and a response.
adaptations: A family sheet can use larger response spaces.
A mobile version preserves route choice and one investigation per screen.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Trebuchet MS is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.
